description: This file exports theme-related functions for applying and retrieving the current theme, specifically handling a dark theme by importing external functions and tokens.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, supporting only 'dark' in this implementation, and returns the token set for styling components.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from the document's data attribute, defaulting to 'dark'.
